title: Method: restart_plugin
description: Restarts an installed plugin without restarting the daemon, whatever its status: a stopped or crashed plugin is launched, and a running or starting one is stopped and launched again (a plugin can be connected and still be stuck). Responds right after spawning, without waiting for the plugin's hello; clients read the outcome with list_plugins, where a failure to start shows up as status 'error'. Bindings are left untouched. An id that is not installed is rejected with PLUGIN_NOT_FOUND.

id.description: Id of the plugin to restart.

result.description: Empty acknowledgement object. Reserved for future fields without breaking the schema.
